subject: Marketplace listing: PO routing, billing contacts, and evidence required
messages:

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing inquiry - onboarding + PO terms

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking a look at NimbusCloud's listing plans — we're excited to get Redwood on the AWS Marketplace. Before we start, procurement asked for a quick checklist so they can route the PO internally. Can you confirm: 1) the billing entity Redwood uses for marketplace invoices, 2) whether you accept Net 30 via marketplace billing, and 3) a short list of security/compliance docs we need to attach (SOC 2, data retention, etc.).

I'm attaching our initial intake form (see attachment stub) and would like to schedule a 30-min call to confirm the PO recipient and signing flow. Proposed times: Thu 5/28 10:00-11:00 PT or Fri 5/29 13:00-14:00 PT.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Reyes
Director, Vendor Programs | NimbusCloud
procurement@nimbuscloud.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reyes <alex.reyes@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing inquiry - onboarding + PO terms

Hi Alex — great to meet you. Short answers up front: 1) Billing for AWS Marketplace listings goes through our marketplace billing entity (Redwood Inference, Inc. via AWS Marketplace SaaS Billing); 2) Marketplace invoices can be accommodated on Net 30 if your procurement team confirms via PO routing — we do not accept off-marketplace Net 30 when the transaction is processed outside marketplace billing; 3) Required docs: SOC 2 Type II summary, data processing addendum (DPA), and a short evidence sheet for any isolation/PII concerns.

I've attached a compact onboarding packet that includes the merchant checklist and the PO template we prefer for marketplace activation. Action items for you:
- Confirm which marketplace (AWS or Azure/GCP) you want us to list under (you mentioned AWS).
- Share preferred billing contact and PO approver name/email.
- If you need a custom payment term exception, flag it now so we can loop in Finance.

I'm happy to run the kickoff call — Thu 5/28 10:00 PT works for me.

Best,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Enterprise GTM | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

Attachments: nimbus_vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf, SOC2_summary.pdf

Olga / team — quick finance update: we can accept Net 30 via Marketplace billing for standard SaaS listings (AWS Marketplace SaaS subscriptions). Two items we need before activation: 1) Signed MSA (DocuSign link preferred) or confirmation we can use the Marketplace contract; 2) Official PO with billing contact and billing address.

I attached the PO_template.docx and our internal PO routing cheat-sheet. If Nimbus needs an exception (longer terms or custom billing entity), we'll need a brief approval from Finance Ops — provide a business justification and target SLA.

Ben — once we receive the PO and MSA, Finance will mark the record and pass to Seller Ops for listing activation. Expect a 3–5 business day window for Marketplace provisioning, assuming no legal holds.
